ctx.x: Uh-huh. Then Marion followed, then Sonny followed it later, different crowd, you know, turned everybody out and he had a good crowd. He asked me to stay to listen to his band, you know, listen to his band. You know what makes me feel good about things like that? He always comes up and say, "Man, I used to listen to Prez and you, man, I used to -- and man, you did a lot. You've influenced me, although I'm playing a different thing," he said, "but I remember how you all used to sound." Well, that's a good feeling,…
made his rehearsal with him and everything and I caught his group and -- did you catch the group that night?
